{{Achievement|Only Santa Brings Gifts|jpg|In the [[Santa's Workshop]] job, secure {{color|value|10}} bags of loot without using any player equipment or assets.}}
{{Achievement|Pumped Up and Jolly|jpg|Complete the [[Santa's Workshop]] job having all players in the crew only use shotguns. Unlocks the “[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Christmas Cap]]” mask.}}
{{Achievement|Santa Slays Slackers|jpg|In the [[Santa's Workshop]] job, keep all the elves alive for {{color|value|30}} minutes after the first assault starts on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.}}

*The teaser achievements and the '''On the Seventh Try on Death Wish, My True Bain Gave to Me''' achievement are references to {{w|Christmas carol|Christmas carols}}, {{w|We Wish You a Merry Christmas}} and {{w|The Twelve Days of Christmas (song)|The Twelve Days of Christmas}}, respectively.
